plan.title: issue-eval Stage A: isolated validity, parent WIP census, value advice

narratives.Description: Operator points at issues; parent fans out read-only evaluators in detached origin/master worktrees for validity; parent on the live working set owns WIP conflict; value may recommend critique without the reserved clearance grammar. No GitHub writes. Stage B is not this issue.
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue #3648. Bind successor lean 5387817441 plus verified-claims table 5387838656. Synthesis accepted 5387842240. Current shape 5387869024. Body is stale (two-stage + .eval candidates log). Supersedes 5387555462 and 5387736216.
narratives.Overview: Split read sources. Verdict sink .deft-scratch/issue-eval/<sha12>/<invocation-id>/ with no assist posture on the CLI parent. Evaluator worktrees .deft-scratch/worktrees/issue-eval-<issue>-<invocation-id>; parent add/remove; evaluators session:start --read-only. Do not reuse swarm:launch until #3649. Fan-out default 4, --concurrency N, REST-first. Decisions stay existing triage:* verbs.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want issues evaluated off master for validity and value, with WIP conflict read from the live working set, so accept does not collide with in-flight work and does not restamp a shipped gap.
narratives.When: When task triage:evaluate runs N issues, evaluators never read or write the shared working tree, the parent writes only the named gitignored sink and named sibling worktrees, origin/master is not checked out or committed to, verdicts stream, no GitHub writes, critique-recommend is not the reserved clearance line, tests pin those rules, and CHANGELOG has an Unreleased line.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Bind 5387817441 + 5387838656. Stage B removed (not residual). Gate vehicle invariance not amended. #3579 is not a hold. Do not widen VALID_DECISIONS. Do not use xbrief/.eval/. Do not emit design-critique: warranted | not warranted, because. Do not edit walk or chip semantics (#3640/#3642/#3646). Do not auto-dispatch critics. Occupancy: sibling worktree is a different lease; evaluators never claim. Teardown on success and failure.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: New contract issue-eval.md. Thin skill + packs:render. triage:evaluate verb owns worktree add/remove and sink write/teardown/GC. Parent WIP census from live xbrief/active pending and plan-sequence. Evaluator validity on detached origin/master. CHANGELOG. Closes #3648. Parallel with #3642 sequence; do not share 3647 files except CHANGELOG append.
narratives.OriginDivergence: Body AC shared-checkout-untouched recut: evaluators never touch shared tree; parent may write named sink and sibling worktrees. Body verdict store and accept-path default flip are superseded. Stage B gone.
